Asset type: production animation sprite sheet for the NotAVirus desktop companion.
Input image: identity/style reference for the jellyfish UFO. Preserve its pearl-silver bell, cyan core, restrained lavender reflections, subtle biomechanical seams, and FIVE substantial curling tendrils. No face, eyes, mouth, saucer disc, or limbs.
Primary request: Draw 16 NEW animation poses of this same character, arranged in exactly FOUR columns and FOUR rows, row-major order, square 1024x1024 PNG. This is a clean game sprite atlas source, not a poster.
Background: genuinely transparent RGBA with alpha zero between silhouettes and in gaps between tendrils. No white background, checkerboard, ground, shadows, ambient haze, decorative lights, text, lines, borders, motion streaks or labels. Internal glow stays INSIDE the bell. Smooth antialiased cutout edges.
Composition: each invisible cell is 256x256; one complete character per cell, never overlapping. Keep anatomical scale consistent across all drawings: relaxed bell about 130px wide, total height about 190px. Center each bell at cell x=128; bell top near y=32. Keep ALL tendrils and tips at least 20px from every cell boundary. Same three-quarter view. Chasing goes to the RIGHT; tendrils trail to the LEFT. Do not enlarge compact or resting poses to fill cells. Elegant quiet curiosity, polished smooth game-character shading and clear silhouettes readable at 128px.
ROW 1, frames 0-3, calm hovering loop: 0 relaxed rounded bell with five hanging curved tendrils; 1 bell slightly expands, core gently brightens, tendrils sway left; 2 bell gently contracts, tips curl inward, core softly dims; 3 relaxed bell again, tendrils sway right. Modest rhythmic changes, not different character designs.
ROW 2, frames 4-7, cyclic propulsion toward RIGHT: 4 broad expanded bell leaning right, tendrils gently sweep left; 5 compact contracting bell leaning right, tendrils curl nearer body; 6 bell releases, extending tendrils behind toward left; 7 recovering rounded bell, tendrils begin curling back. Constraints: exactly 16 isolated complete sprites, no extras. Preserve strong pearl/cyan/lavender identity from reference, soft volume, substantial tendrils. Genuine transparency, consistent drawing scale, no labels.

Only the 16 complete jellyfish silhouettes (their bells and five attached tendrils) may have nonzero alpha. notes: Original generated RGBA source is preserved.
